chronology: Written after reading published outcomes and completing the selected-field workbook appraisal; before executable endpoint-bound calculation. Used-source development, not preregistration or independent validation.

source_locators.assigned: Primary publication Results: Participants, page 10; Control 507 and Intervention 500.
source_locators.recorded_positive_and_known: Primary publication Results: Incidence of diabetes, page 12; Control 79/463 and Intervention 68/456.
source_locators.cumulative_deaths: Primary publication Figure 1, page 11; Control 1 and Intervention 2 at both nominal follow-up horizons. Do not sum across horizons.

observations: Literal total recorded diabetes-incidence Yes/No/absent, not current glucose category, untreated remission, onset date, or latent state.
all_assigned_estimand: Finite-cohort fraction positive under every binary completion of unknown recorded endpoints. Death does not erase an earlier recorded diagnosis.
survivor_estimand: Separate conditional finite-cohort fraction among survivors, assuming the reported cumulative death counts exhaust the same assigned cohorts; every allocation of unlinked deaths to endpoint groups is admitted. This assumption is explicit and not source-certified linkage.
contrast: Intervention minus control; exact extremal count ratios, no independent-binomial sampling model or confidence interval. Between-arm risk differences do not identify an isolated food effect.
tipping: Enumerate aggregate missing-positive counts in each arm; classify each pair using integer cross-products. Export counts of compatible pairs only, never participant paths, IDs or cluster keys.
raw_replay: Optional pinned public workbooks: verify existing registered aggregate replay, then compare broad arm-by-total-endpoint counts to registered primary-publication counts. No raw record or labeled multiwave trajectory export.
stop_conditions: Invalid or nonconserving counts, unsupported endpoint or assignment labels, source pin mismatch or publication/workbook denominator disagreement stop dependent calculation.
No independent-censoring assumption, temporal hazard conversion, diagnosis erasure, cluster-independent confidence interval, U.S. transport or engine activation.
